message:
Let me look at how the GUID default value is handled in the rustgen code, and how the validation works.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd && sed -n '140,170p' libfwupdplugin/fu-rustgen-struct.c.in; echo "==="; sed -n '180,210p' libfwupdplugin/fu-rustgen-struct.c.in; echo "==="; grep -n "default\|validate" libfwupdplugin/rustgen.py | head -30</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
